diagnosis: The endpoint accepts report_id from the URL and enqueues a background task to render the report and send it to user.email. It performs no ownership check on report_id prior to enqueuing the job, enabling an attacker to trigger generation and delivery of any user's confidential financial report directly to the attacker's inbox.
exploit_request:
POST /reports/3091/generate-pdf HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
